levels.down: The last torch goes out behind its own flame. Nothing down here has a face any more.

levels.up: One torch opens an eye, and shuts it again when you look.
levels.down: The torches have shut their eyes as you go by.

levels.up: The torches look at you again, sidelong.
levels.down: The torches look away from you.

levels.up: The torches turn back to you.
levels.down: The torches stop leaning your way.

levels.up: The torches lean in as you pass. They seem glad.
